definitions.explanation: Soldiers who fight on foot, as opposed to cavalry or other mounted troops. Also refers to the infantry branch of a military force.

examples.japanese: {歩兵|ほへい}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{前進|ぜんしん}した→前進する：17339_zenshinsuru⟧。
⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歩兵|ほへい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: On the battlefield, the infantry suffered the most casualties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{歩兵|ほへい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変化|へんか}した→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧。
examples.english: In modern warfare, the role of infantry has changed significantly.

notes:
{歩兵|ほへい} refers to soldiers who fight on foot, as distinct from cavalry, artillery, or other branches.

FORMS:
⟦{歩|ほ}→〜歩：00108_ho⟧ (walk) + ⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧ (soldier).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歩兵|ほへい}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧: infantry unit
- {歩兵|ほへい}{連隊|れんたい}: infantry regiment
- {歩兵|ほへい}{師団|しだん}: infantry division

SHOGI NOTE:
In ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ (Japanese chess), the pawn piece is written {歩兵|ふひょう} — note the different reading. It is commonly abbreviated to {歩|ふ}.

RELATED MILITARY TERMS:
- ⟦{騎兵|きへい}→騎兵：18012_kihei⟧: cavalry
- ⟦{砲兵|ほうへい}→砲兵：18085_houhei⟧: artillery
- ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: soldier (general term)
